pathways.title: MAM competition licence pathway
steps: Join a MAM-affiliated club and keep proof of club membership
Complete a medical examination (ECG commonly required) using the MAM medical form
Prepare application materials (IC, photo, blood group, payment) as listed on the licence form

Choose the road-racing licence grade published on the form — National A / National B (and National C if offered for the year) vs International A / International B (International grades subject to FIM on the form)
Submit via https://license-mam.com/pubLicenseForm (required) or MAM office / designated 2-wheel contact
Enter MAM-sanctioned events such as MSBK with the matching grade
pathways.notes: High-level only — no invented clause numbers or fees. Grades are as listed on license-mam.com (National A/B, International). Portal is required for 2026 applications.
